fields.Name: Tasks
fields.Description: Parent authorization for BizApps Tasks administrative and management permissions.

fields.Name: Manage Time Entries
fields.Description: Allows logging, editing, or deleting TaskTimeEntry rows and starting or stopping TaskTimer rows on behalf of any person.

fields.Name: Manage Timesheets
fields.Description: Allows submitting or withdrawing timesheets on behalf of any person, reopening Approved timesheets, and managing TimeApprover and TimesheetSchedule rules.
